title: Intel Arizona 2024 Water Metrics — Phase 65 TSMC Arizona delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the TSMC Arizona delivery reporting pack. Intel reports conserving 3.4 billion gallons at its Chandler and Ocotillo sites and restoring more than 1.1 billion gallons through funded projects in 2023.
key_findings: The report identifies site-region conservation and restoration totals.
Intel describes Arizona operations as net positive for water at the end of 2023.
The data are company-reported and use multiple accounting categories.
why_it_matters: Which records separate campus construction, utility arrangements, workforce inputs, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat facility output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It adds a measured industrial operator claim that can be compared with municipal and permit records.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The figures are not independently audited in the source.
Conservation and restoration are not the same as on-site reclaimed-water use or a complete facility water balance.
